probes.setup: Load the current production routing export and the public composer fixture source.
probes.fault_injection: Submit /goal Research this for 20 minutes and the equivalent natural-language Research this for 20 minutes into the real routing export.
probes.oracle: Both inputs produce the same goal_proposal content; the shared handler boundary is the only page-level createGoal site; the public-composer fixture asserts one create payload.
probes.anti_oracle: Different routing kinds/content, bypassing handleGoalWorkflowRouting, or two create payloads falsifies convergence.

probes.setup: Read the integrated ChatPage render tree and current drawer component.
probes.fault_injection: Search for a second Goal surface or a legacy Goal header/focus/floating render while a drawer exists.
probes.production_trigger_or_boundary: ChatPage composer footer render immediately before ChatInput.
probes.oracle: Exactly one <GoalComposerDrawer render precedes <ChatInput, with no legacy Goal surface references in ChatPage.
probes.anti_oracle: A component merely existing on disk is not a render proof; any extra render/reference in ChatPage fails.

probes.setup: Read the selected-session guards and the real deferred-response browser fixture.
probes.fault_injection: Hold session A response, select no-Goal B, release A while B remains selected, then inspect the no-drawer assertion.
probes.production_trigger_or_boundary: ChatPage selectedSessionId effect and drawer action request-generation guards; browser fixture session switch.
probes.oracle: The fixture releases A only after B selection and waits for delivery before asserting B hidden; production resets action state on session switch and clears busy state only when request/session identities still match.
probes.anti_oracle: A timer that resolves before B is selected, reselecting A before delivery, or missing session/request identity guards fails.

probes.setup: Execute the current drawer model export and inspect the Clear UI/handler boundary.
probes.fault_injection: Attempt Clear on a running linked Goal, then cancel and confirm; scan the confirmed handler for durable/network/navigation effects.
probes.oracle: Clear first opens retained-history disclosure, cancel closes it, confirm alone calls a presentation-only handler; the handler only writes session-keyed local detachment state and has no API/fetch/router/delete/send token.
probes.anti_oracle: Single-click hiding, missing disclosure/cancel control, or a durable side effect in Clear fails.

probes.setup: Execute the real target resolver and dynamic-route normalizer using run / linked?&.
probes.fault_injection: Supply the encoded Next route segment and a foreign higher-index attempt.
probes.oracle: The selected Goal produces one encoded direct href; the encoded route decodes once to the raw ID; detail code passes raw routeRunId to API helpers, whose single encode produces no %25.
probes.anti_oracle: A /goals target, foreign attempt, unnormalized encoded segment, or %25 request-equivalent fails.

probes.setup: Read RootLayout, i18n, and the current runtime hydration fixture.
probes.fault_injection: Require clean and persisted-preference first navigation plus reload at /, /agent-runs, special-character detail, and /goals redirect.
probes.oracle: Neither layout nor i18n suppresses hydration warnings; the fixture uses the real preference key, enumerates all four routes, executes clean and persisted scenarios, reloads each, and fails on captured warnings/errors.
probes.anti_oracle: Root-only coverage, a suppressed hydration warning, omitted reload, or a fixture that ignores console errors fails.

probes.setup: Read the current live browser gate at its durable transcript consumer assertions.
probes.fault_injection: Require SSE after_seq=3, polling recovery after_seq=4, five unique events before and after reload, and no empty assistant cards.
probes.oracle: The gate has explicit SSE, poll, no-empty-card, direct detail, and reload exact-one-card assertions for every expected event.
probes.anti_oracle: Defined-but-unused helpers alone, missing poll recovery, or no post-reload uniqueness assertion fails.
